dish-cucumber.definition: Threshold alpha >=128; visible width is occupied alpha bbox width. Actual bottom rim support is the center of the lowest opaque row span, at pixel centers. Preserve canonical full raster and full [0,1] UV with one uniform mapping, not the source padded quad corners.
